نستسلم (form X)
# نَسْتَسْلِمُ (nastaslimu) /nas.tas.li.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَسْلَمَ (istaslama)
# نَسْتَسْلِمَ (nastaslima) /nas.tas.li.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَسْلَمَ (istaslama)
# نَسْتَسْلِمْ (nastaslim) /nas.tas.lim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَسْلَمَ (istaslama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
